system.description:
Carapace armor combines bioweave armor with hard but flexible plates of a chitin-ceramic hybrid material modeled on the microscopic structure and texture of arthropod exoskeletons. This armor is obvious and has a somewhat crocodilian or insectoid appearance (character’s choice). The morph is completely hairless as well. This provides an Armor rating of 11/11. This armor is not cumulative with worn armor.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 303.
